title: peristrophe bicalyculata
intro: Peristrophe bicalyculata, commonly known as the Indian bugloss or golden fingers, is a plant species in the Acanthaceae family, known for its vibrant yellow flowers. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. Peristrophe bicalyculata is also reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antidiabetic, and antihypertensive properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
